rows.TEXT: Sea Serpent Of The Undead Sea
Dark Elf Gast Of The Undead
Sea Serpent Of The Dead Seas

Ashgan 
"The Undead Hordes rule this realm! You shall be reminded every ten days just how powerful we are! Fall before our might and join your fallen allies in death!"
"The gold resource is heavily protected by the decayed branches. Let us keep and look out for more gold. By capturing the resources we will weaken our enemy while making us stronger!"
"The Grove Mana must be ours! I find it disgusting that the Undead Hordes are benefitting from this resource. We shall take it and make ourselves stronger at the Undead Hordes's expense!"

"The gold on that island is heavily protected! We are at a disadvantage the Undead Hordes have dominated this region and its resources. We must take everything that we can. If we do not take the resources or the valuables our enemy will!"

"We cannot allow the Undead Hordes to further benefit from this Infernal mana. The Infernal mana and their own Undead mana will allow them to access higer level spells to use against us. We must take this resource to cut of their mana supply! "
"I do not feel easy! I can almost sense an attack from the Undead Hordes! We have to take these resources. We will weaken them at all costs!"

Oracle Elf 
"You were right! The Undead Hordes own this realm! We must proceed with caution. I can feel that Gallean is upset with what has happened to you. Try to find the waterfalls they will heal the weak. We can save on gold and resources! Wait.I."

Oracle Elf 
"I was going to say that I felt a sense of power surge through me as I was talking to you. Gallean watches out for us, I am pleased. Great Gallean will assist us on our holy quest! Be careful my friend for the Undead Hordes wait for us!"
"Foul creature of death! We are here to liberate the souls that your demented Mortis has taken from us! We do not fear the Undead Hordes!"

Vampire 
"Your bold words do not belong here. Look around we have seen many Elves before you come to liberate the fallen Dark Elves. Gallean has sent you on another fool's Quest and you shall join the fate of all those Elves before you!"

Oracle Elf 
"I can feel the power of Gallean! He looks down on you with pride. Make Gallean proud and destroy the Undead Hordes and liberate the Dark Elves!"

Oracle Elf 
"Gallean speaks to me. I can hear him, he says to tell you that he is watching over you. He has provided you with these items to aid you in your battle against the gathering forces of the Undead Hordes! Destroy these dark agents!"

Bone Lord 
"Leave this realm at once! Here the Undead Hordes are power supreme. Many of the creatures  that you encounter are more powerful than they otherwise would be. Do not enter this ruin for I crave blood and I will take yours!"

Oracle Elf 
"Do not listen to the Bone Lord! He is corrupt and is warped by Mortis's hatred! You must go in there and defeat him and all of these undead creatures! Gallean wills it to so and we do not want to anger him. Already I can feel his rage!"

Oracle Elf 
"Here take this it shall improve your aim. Gallean needs us the defeat these dark forces and to liberate the Dark Elves. We can bring them back into the light and forge ahead to a bright future!"
"Those bones, look closely! Elves, they have butchered Elves and put them out on display. The Undead Hordes must be defeated! If not, they may try to butcher all of us! We will avenge them!"

Oracle Elf 
"Gallean is pleased! He can feel the anger swelling up in you and is happy that you take this Quest personally! The Dark Elves must be freed from the grip of the Undead Hordes! I can sense Gallean is about to act."
"Behold the dark city Arcania. It is said that great evil magic is devised here. The Necromancers who rule the area dedicate their efforts to corrupting magic! We must proceed with caution!"

Necromancer Lich Queen 
"Your presssence!  Doesss not go unexpected! This realm belongssss to the Undead Hordesss. We ssssee everything, we hear everything. Listen closely, listen to the screamsssss. Can you tell me what those ssssoundsssssssss are?"

Oracle Elf 
"Those screams! They sound like Elves being tortured! Gallean's rage grows I can feel his anger building! We must do something! We must set free those that are in torment! We must liberate those that are within!"

Necromancer Lich Queen 
"You sssshall do nothing sssave be absorbed by this realm's corrupting influence. Sssoon  you ssshall be fighting among yourselvessss. I shall ssspare you that fate, you ssshall not live to see another moment. Ssscream for me!"

"Let us take a moment shall we! I want to honor those who fell before us. In this constant struggle against the gathering darkness we must take the time to remember those who fell so that we may live. In time we may join these souls! Rest well!"

Oracle Elves 
"Your words have not gone unheard. Great Gallean wishes to reward you! You are pure of heart and a noble spirit. Rest assured that Gallean is proud of you. We did not want this fight, we will see that it comes to an end!"

Lich Queen 
"Slowly! Slowly you will rot from within and join the fallen Elves! Scream along with the Elves that we torture on a daily basis!"

"Proceed with caution. We are far from home. I suspect that the evil in this realm grows with each passing minute. I can sense that we are being watched. The nearby cave, I can sense corrupt magic in there. Let us keep our health potions ready!"

"Stand back! These trail markings suggest that a Manticore could be in the area. Hopefully this vile creature has met its defeat prior to our arrival. Mortis influences the strength of the creatures in this realm!"

Oracle Elf 
"Gallean fears for your well being. He does not want you to fall to the might of the Undead Hordes. We will liberate the Dark Elves from this gothic realm. Gallean only wishes the best for you! Take care of yourself, victory be with you!"

Oracle Elf 
"The Undead Hordes are vicous, they own this realm! Everystep must be measured with great caution. May Gallean watch over you!"

Erhog the Necromancer 
"Tonight my tortured spirit shall be at ease. For I shall consume Galleans' Light!"

"The Undead Sea is home of unusual creatures. We must proceed with caution, though some creatures may appear familiar they may in fact be unusually powerful. A Leviathan Kraken is suppose to be around here!"

Death Knight 
"Elven Alliance! You dare enter this realm where our power grows with each passing day. With each death we grow stronger! Mortis watches you as Gallean watches you. Only she will punish you for being here! Leave or join the Dark Elves!"

Lich  
"Ha, ha, ha! More Elves have arrived for the banquet of the dead. On the menu misguided Elvesssssssss! Each step that you take can cause a chain reaction ending with your downfall! Leave this place, or join us for dinner!"

Oracle Elf 
"Fear not! Gallean loves you and will never abandon you in this hour of need. I can hear his voice! He speaks to me, I can hear him tell me that you are the one to liberate the Elves from this place. He shall never abandon you!"

Oracle Elf 
"Be warned! Mortis does indeed watch over this place and the Undead Hordes are at their strongest! Don't despair for Gallean will intervene when necessary! Remember that Gallean loves the Elves that is why we are here!"

Death Knight 
"Elvesss, shall suffer the fate of those that they ssssseeek to liberate!"
"This realm is full of foul evil! We must be on our guard at all costs! Mortis and her Hordes of the Undead seek to add us to the unholy banquet!"

Bone Lord 
"Help me! I was a fool! Once I had a thirst for power and eternal life. Mortis granted that wish at a price. I must feed, I must feed off the blood of others. I am sorry, I do what I must to feed my thirst. We are many, fools are numerous!"

Bone Lord 
"Look upon you Elves! You are far from your home! The Undead Hordes are the unquestioned rulers of this realm! New and familiar faces roam this realm. Like them, I hunger, I hunger for your death. You will never leave this place!"

Oracle Elf 
"Stay away from this place! You will not survive! The triangle of Skeletons is where Mortis shall poison those she declares her enemies. Leave now! Only by finding the soul dagger and bringing it here can we avert this curse."

Oracle Elf 
"You have done well Gallean will be pleased by your success! We have disabled one of the Undead Hordes defenses. Hold on to the Soul Dagger, I fear that we may still require its presence."

Cendyll the Dryad 
"Gallean be praised! I am free from the frigid grip of Mortis! I will assist you on this Quest to free the others! Together we will show Gallean that he is wise to watch over us!"

Oracle Elf 
"I can feel sense Galleans' satisfaction. The land around us has changed. I hope this means that he is overpowering the darkness within this realm!"

Oracle Elf 
"Our beloved Gallean is pleased that you have set free another prisoner. This poor unfortunate soul had been tortured by the darkness for too long. The land now reflects Gallean's happiness."

Bone Lord 
"Elves! Your presence here in our realm angers us! You shall be defeated be certain of that! The Undead Hordes shall add you to our collection of impaled Elves!"

Ashgan 
"Little Elves, you are going to suffer a fate worse than death. Eternal torment awaits you once you have fallen to our unholy might!"
"In the name of the Alliance I declare this city free! No longer will the Undead Hordes rule this city! Let peace reign in this city and the next!"

Lich 
"Fffffffffrrrreeeedoommmm! Sssssuch words burnssss in herrrre. Ssssooon the light will go out!"

Illumielle 
"This is our last hope to secure our borders and to defeat the Undead Hordes. Gallean has forsaken us and we are stranded in this realm of the dead filled with ancient battlefields."

Oracle Elf 
"Strangely, I feel as though that Gallean is watching us as we speak. Either he is preparing to strike us down or his anger has passed. I feel that his hatred has subdued."

Illumielle 
"Oracle, we must be wary of Gallean's temperamental ways! Le us all know if something more comes to you. In the mean time, we must fight and perepl this Undead aggression and secure our people!"

Oracle Elf 
"My Queen, I have felt that someone is coming our way and that he comes in the name of Gallean. I feel that we should allow this messenger a chance to speak. He comes in peace!"

Illumielle 
"We shall allow this messenger a chance to speak! Be on guard history has taught us that appearances can be deceiving."

Envoy Angus 
"I arrive here in peace with a message from Gallean. Our Lord is pleased with you Illumielle. As Gallean's envoy I shall not suffer death as an Elf. With this promise I have given my life to him for he is the one true God of the Elves."

Envoy Angus 
"I know that that you do not like me. Due to our past I do not blame you. However I am here to tell you that Gallean has forgiven you for your temper and failure to see the big picture. We have to free the Dark Elves."

Oracle Elf 
"My Queen, I can sense that Gallean is no longer upset. I feel his undying love for us and he repents as to what has happened to us. We must free the Dark Elves, I can hear their screams my Queen.

Illumielle 
"Very well, your point is taken Oracle Elf. However I am not a fool and Envoy Angus you cannot be trusted. We will liberate the Dark Elves however you will not aid us. Our love is for Gallean and not you. Leave us!"

Illumielle 
"We will find the rune and bring it to the sacred city before Mortis can raise the souls of the Dark Elves. The Undead ritual of raising the Dark Elves shall be terminated once and for all. Envoy Angus leave us."

Ashgan 
"I have decimated everyone in that city! Elves you are in the wrong realm! The entire Alliance will join the Dark Elves in eternal torment! With minds so twisted by Mortis you shall attack your own friends!"

Ashgan 
"Undead Hordes! Gather, the Elves must join their the others. Eternal torture awaits for anyone who dares enter this realm uninvited!"

Vampire 
"Listen to me and hear my words! This is our realm. The Undead Hordes may fall in battle, know that there will be others to take the place of the fallen. Bewarned that the waters are just as dangerous as the land!"

Vampire 
"As you know, all Vampires at the core of their cold black hearts are gentlemen. I wish you luck, however know that Mortis is influential. During the course of your Quest haven't you noticed that your allies have betrayed you?"
"All right! Undead filth! Where is the your twisted sacred Unholy city? Tell me now!"

Wraith 
"In the far east, then go north! There you shall find the city that you seek! However you will never make it there alive. Ashgan sees all and you do not! The darkness covers the terrors that await you. This city is yours for the moment!"

Ashgan 
"Venture into the darkness at your own peril Elves. This realm belongs to the Undead Hordes! You shall never know what awaits you within the darkness!"

Illumielle 
"This realm has me disturbed! I suggest leaving some fighters behind with me to defend the capital. After our last adventure we cannot be certain that I won't be attacked!"

Oracle Elf 
"Fear not! Whatever dangers we shall face we will not do so alone. Great Gallean watches over us! He loves us very much and does not wish to see us suffer."

Illumielle 
"I understand that Gallean watches over us! Still I would feel better that I have some support here. Should the capital fall all is lost. I do not dare chance the well being of our people! Gallean is strong and I love him. I fear Mortis!"

Oracle Elf 
"My Queen, how can you doubt Gallean. He is all powerful and Mortis would not dare have her undead minions assault us! Gallean will see to our protection, please do not doubt Gallean, I fear that it may anger him!"

Illumielle 
"Silence! Despite your undying love for Gallean he has not helped us. In fact, I am weakened because of him and his punishment upon the Elves. If Gallean does care for us he will send us a messenger to tell us so!"

Oracle Elf 
"I beg your pardon my Queen. I know that Gallean has been tempermental, but if we do not have faith then all is lost. I can sense his many moods and I fear his anger, but I am confident that we shall be provided for! I will say no more!"

Dwarf King Mad Hammer 
"You fool! What dark path have you undertaken. I have aided you in your hour of need! Do not take this rune is shall be everyone's undoing!"

Illumielle 
"I am sorry that our paths have to cross like this. Despite my mistrust of the Mountain Clans you Mad Hammer stood by us in our hour of darkness. I do what I must for I answer only to Gallean and this is his will. I am sorry!"

Oracle Elf 
"We must help Gallean. Mortis has twisted the minds of the Dark Elves, they have attacked us in the past. Though it is not their fault. We must take the rune to the city of Lost Souls. There we can undo Mortis's evil."

Illumielle 
"I know what must be done though I have my hesitations. Our Lord Gallean has been acting unusual. Envoy Angus slaughtered numerous creatures and people in Gallean's name. We are falling into a dark path."

Oracle Elf 
"My Queen, I cannot believe what you have just said. I must remind you that it is not up to us to question Gallean. He is beyond our understanding and we must accept that he works in mysterious ways. Do not doubt him!"

Illumielle 
"Your words have wisdom behind them. We will bring the rune to the city of Lost Souls and put an end to this twisted nightmare! Praise Gallean!"

Illumielle 
"The rune can be found in Wotan's Tower! We must topple the tower at all cost!"

Oracle Elf 
"Praise Gallean! You have removed the last obstacle. Go and coquer the City Of Lost Souls and we shall put an end to Mortis's evil. The Dark Elves shall be forevermore free!"

Illumielle 
"Enough! We do not have time to praise anyone. Just north of Vampyre city a path way has been revealed. We shall follow it to the final city."

Dark Lachla'an 
"This realm is not for the likes of the Alliance. It shall be by my hand that your Quest ends!"

Oracle Elf 
"Do not let these setbacks hold us up! I can sense that Gallean's excitement. Go now, leave behind that rogue Dark Elf and make your way through the mountain path! Gallean wants you to set the Elves free! Know that his love is with you!"

"I am frustrated! I want to know where the city of Lost Souls can be found! I will destroy everything in this realm if I have to! Gallean's will shall prevail over Mortis's hold over the Dark Elves! Now tell me!"

Lich Queen 
"The rage! The rage within you is very impressive! Mortis would be pleased to have you fight in her name! I do not know where the city is. However bring the rune to Vampyre City and they shall show you the City Of Lost Souls!"

Ashgan 
"Your presence here has upset the Undead Hordes! Listen to the screams of your fallen brethren! Join them you shall! The darkness will consume you the life out of you!"
"Here in Wotan's tower we must battle to take the rune from those who dwell within!"

Dwarf King Mad Hammer   
"Halt! Despite our past I cannot allow you into this tower. The magical rune will stay in the hands of the Mountain Clans. We cannot allow either the Elves or the Undead Hordes to get their hands on this. I am sorry! Leave!"

Illumielle 
"Dwarf King Mad Hammer! Don't be a fool, we do not have any choice Gallean commands us. Who are we to question Gallean would you in turn question your Lord Wotan? This tower must fall!"

"These prison towers are holding some of the most powerful creatures ever! There is great reward in looting these towers. The danger though is great. We need to be prepared if we are going to take down these prison towers!"

Oralce Elf 
"Be rest assured that Gallean is looking over you! Everything will be fine, go on in there and defeat the horrors within. Gallean will see to it that you are blessed!"

Ashgan 
"Fear me and the Hordes! Each step in the darkness can invite horror! Pain will be inflicted upon the children of Gallean! You shall know pain unlike anything you have experienced before!"

Oracle Elf 
"Fear not! Gallean believes in you and you have been given this potion from our loving Lord! Go with courage and face whatever the darkness may through at you. Do so knowing that Gallean loves you!"

Envoy Angus 
"The pain! Gallean why have you forsaken me! I cannot be defeated again by the Elven Alliance! I am your chosen one preserve me!"

Oracle Elf 
"My Lord! I am terrified of Gallean's rage! There is something not right something sinister building in Gallean! I am terrified, I can no longer hear his soft voice. All I can feel is sheer pain and anger!"

Bone Lord 
"Nearby where the land is burning with brimstone. There is a tower where the Overlord resides! Within the Overlord's tower is the staff of daylight. Those who use this staff can remove the entire fog of war! The tower has a lot of gold!"
"I want the staff of daylight! With this staff we can remove the fog of war and finally see where we are going!"

Dryad Green 
"Finally freedom! The Overlord had me trapped in  his tower! We were tortured, thankfully you have saved us! I can use the staff of daylight on your behalf. We shall free the Dark Elves!"

Illumielle 
"Watch her! My heart has not turned to stone however I would be foolish to trust anyone anymore! In our previous Quest those who we thought we loyal betrayed us! Keep an eye on Dryad Green! I do not wish for us to be fooled again!"

Manticore 
"Elves are such amusing creatures! The Gods have not favored your presence and yet here you are carrying on in a mission that has you divided. I have a challenge for you my cereberal meal. Accept my challenge and should you be victorious!"

Manticore 
"Should you win! I will reward you with wealth. I will give you Bethrezen's Claw and I will reward you with knowledge that you desperately need! The choice is yours I will not attack you. Attack me and the challenge shall begin."

Manticore 
"Please decide quickly! For I cannot promise that my brothers will not force me to attack you! I am patient unlike them. Decided quickly, fight and win and I shall reward you greatly. Fight and lose and nothing shall matter anymore, my meal!

Oracle Elf 
"Do not trust the Manticore! The vile creatures will not tell you anything! Gallean wishes you well. He advises against you fighting the creature! Gallean's boon has been casted upon you in case you are attacked! Leave by order of Gallean!"

Manticore 
"Your precious Lord fears the knowledge that I may provide you my delicous Elf! Perhaps like a good little lackey you should listen to your invisible master! Though knowledge wasted is a tragedy. The choice is yours, hurry for I hunger!"

Oracle Elf 
"Gallean has cursed you for speaking to the forbidden creature!"

Manticore 
"You are a worthy champion. I did not believe that you little Elf had it in you. My brothers and I are not easily defeated. You have won on this day before I die I shall tell you what you need to know! I shall tell you everything!"

Manticore 
"I shall tell you all that I know about the secrets that Mortis and Gallean share. For you see you already know that the two were once very much in love. Despite all that has happened love has a way of resurfacing. Gallean is not....!"

Oracle Elf 
"Fool! What are you doing! A divine order was given not to talk to the Manticore! Gallean is angrier than ever, fortunately all wise Gallean has forgiven you. A little bit of knowledge out of context can be dangerous!"

Oracle Elf 
"Be fortunate that the Manticore died before he could further poison your mind. Gallean is great, Gallean is absolute and wise. You will be wise to understand these three truths! For the love of Gallean do not stray again!"

"The Manticore! These creatures are rarely seen, however in this land of the dead they seem to be many. We must be cautious they can just sit there and amuse themselves by watching or they can attack us in a moment's notice!"

Oracle Elf 
"The foul beasts must never be trusted or talked to. This is Gallean's law he does not trust those troublesome creatures! Stay clear from them they will not offer you anything of value!"

Manticore 
"Elves! You are a long way from the safety of your homes! Lost you are and you do not even know why you are here. I sense confusion and mistrust in your souls. Have you been betrayed will you be betrayed again only the Manticores know!"

Illumielle 
"Foul creature! Great Gallean has instructed us not to talk to you loathsome creature! Stay where you are or we shall remove your spirit from your body with our swords!"

Manticore 
"Brave words, oh yes very brave indeed! As shame that such bold words are not backed up by power. Instead a frightened confused Elf stands before me. I hunger, I will provide you a challenge. I know all about the Braggi's Battle Rune!"

Manticore 
"I propose that we my dear little intimidated frightened Elf that we battle. Should you be victorious I shall tell you that I know about the Battle Rune. Should you lose well both your problems and my hunger will be no more!"

Oracle Elf 
"You fool! I told you that Gallean' does not want you talking to these creatures! This beast is setting to attack! Run or do battle but decide now!"

Manticore 
"I shall never worry about hunger again shall I? The Battle Rune that the Elves possess belongs to the city of Vampyre! Bring the item to this city and the mountains themselves will bow down to you and reveal the city of Lost Souls!"

Illumielle 
"Cursed creature died much too quickly! I wanted the loathsome beast to suffer. Bringing the Battle Rune will bring us closer to victory. Though I wish the Manticore had told us more. Perhaps other Manticores can be more helpful!"

Oracle Elf 
"My Queen, you can possible suggest that we attack the Manitcore's Gallean will be most displeased. You do recall what happened the last time you lost Gallean's favor. The Orcs nearly captured defeated you! The Manticores are evil!"

Illumielle 
"I recall vividly what happened the last time Gallean abandoned me. The Orcs nearly defeated me. I do know that Gallean has not been too helpful and that we are here on a mission to free the Dark Elves. The same Elves that want us dead!"

Oracle Elf 
"Your words are too bold my Queen! Gallean will see that we are punished if we continue to mock him! Please apologize before Gallean turns his back on us anymore! I beg you my Queen do so before!"

Ashgan 
"Fools! You bicker when the entire realm watches you and laughs! Gallean is a fool, only those who follow Mortis will be triumphant! Your bickering will lead to your downfall. Behold the power that you face!"

Ashgan 
"Be warned! That you may not see what is in the dark! The darkness however can see you! Venture into the unknown at your own risk! Manticores are very vengeful when hungry!"

Envoy Angus 
"My Lord! I continue to serve in your name! I cannot wait for the day that Illumielle pays for her wicked ways! I shall consider it an honor to destroy the vile witch myself! Praise Gallean!"

Envoy Angus 
"Yes my Lord, I hear you and I obey! The Elven Alliance must be destroyed! Illumielle is not fit to lead, I know this. The banished Elf Queen is a failure! I know Gallean, I shall fight to restore the Elves! I shall destroy the Alliance!"

Death Knight 
"Fool! You have unleashed a terrible force! In time this force shall be revealed and you will suffer!"

Envoy Angus 
"Great Gallean I can hear you calling my name. I raise these creatures in honor of you my Lord! Let these dark creatures cleanse the Alliance of all those that have doubted your power. Let Illumielle die for her sins! Praise Gallean!"

Oracle Elf 
"Do not worry! Envoy Angus has been through a great ordeal and has become insane. Do not be worried, Gallean loves you! He loves all of us very much! Gallean is the light and he shall guide us to victory! We must defeat Envoy Angus!"

Dark Envoy Angus 
"Gallean I hear your calling and you are right! Illumielle shall die! Show me that you are with me! My Lord send your servant of destruction to fight alongside of me! Let Illumielle know that her days are numbered!"

Oracle Elf 
"My Queen, I can no longer sense Gallean he has left us! We are doomed, aaaahhhh, the pain! Gallean why do you torture me I have been loyal to you! Aaaahhhh!"

Illumielle 
"Our greatest battle is to come! Elves everywhere return to me and defend your Queen against a God gone mad! Dark Envoy Angus is a servant of Gallean and he wishes destroy us! The Dark Elves and Mortis have corrupted our loving Gallean!"

Dark Envoy Angus 
"Beg for your life! Beg and pray and you will see that you have become prey! Gallean has left you my Queen. Gallean is now the God of the Dark Elves! Soon you shall know eternal pain! Praise Gallean!"

"Stay back, There is danger here! The Manticore's are tricky vile creatures! They make great promises only rarely do they deliver upon those promises. If we see one we must be careful for they can attack within an instant. They move swiftly!"

Oracle Elf 
"Gallean does not want you to speak or acknowledge the Manticore. The most vile of these creatures is the false Saint. Years ago, the so called St.Devors had a congregation. Squires from the Empire and the Imperial Priests were attending!"

Oracle Elf 
"The congregation was filled with joyous activities and delightful music! At the conclusion of the congregation St. Devors revealed his true self. Standing before the horrified people was a blood thirsty Manticore, a king Manticore."

"St.Devors in his true form swiftly jumped into the crowd. His lion like body was heavy and he would crush his prey and then slowly devour them while listening to delightful music! The Empire in a rage found the creature as it slaughtered an Arch-Angel."

"St.Devors merely smiled as he tore the wings off of the Arch-Angel. The butchery was so vulgar that the skies opened up and a dozen Angels flew down and joined the Empire in battling this beast. A black cloud appeared and St.Devors vanished!"

St.Devors  
"My reputation appears to preceed me. Although to my defense the story isn't accurate. See it was not one Arch-Angel I had a pile of Arch-Angels that I feasted upon. I enjoyed that fine meal, and I hunger once more as do my brothers!"

St.Devors 
"I shall make you an offer. Please hear me out for I am civilized and cultured! I shall not attack you at the moment. I would suggest a battle if you will. Should you win, I shall tell you how you can win the might of a Grave Golem!"

Manticore St.Devors 
"Now if you should lose, I will of course satisfy my hunger. I enjoy food more after it puts up a fight. I suppose it is the savage instinct within me. However I am allowed the luxury. Should you decline, I will be angered!"

"I shall take it upon myself to hunt and find Illumielle. I shall defeat her and you shall never know the secret of the Grave Golem! A pity really, those foolish creatures are very powerful. Nature's gift for their lack of strategic planning, I imagine."

Oracle Elf 
"Leave this place at once. Illumielle can handle St.Devors, that beast is stronger than any Manticore that preceeded him. He is a king of all ill and loathsome creatures. Run and Illumielle shall handle this creature."
"If these tracks do not deceive me. Not only is the Manticore here. However one of our own has been captured by this beast! If we slaughter this beast we can perhaps free her."

Oracle Elf 
"Do not be foolish! The Manticore's are not to be trusted. This could very well be a false trail. Gallean does not approve and you shall be without his guidance if you wish to confront St.Devors!"

Oracle Elf 
"Gallean will not stand by and see you die a fool's death. Should you find yourself in battle with St.Devors this artifact will allow you to flee!"

Manticore St Devors 
"The void of oblivion calls unto me. There  shall be no more delightful music. My hunger shall torment me for an eternity. My ill fated meal I shall tell you what you desire to know. Take this iron key, and bring it to the prison."

Manticore St.Devors 
"Bring the key to the Golem prison tower. Once you arrive a mighty Golem will appear and fight upon your behalf. The Golem shall help you. You are a worthy warrior and you deserve everything that fate as in store for you!"

Manticore St Devors 
"You are so mighty in fact that my brothers will not be a match for you. Go on and defeat them and some will tell you the truth that you need to know while others will silently await for death. I salute you this one final time!"

"The Manticore is a tricky beast. Prepare for battle. We were lead to believe that we were freeing a fallen friend. Then we were lead to believe that this Key shall release a Grave Golem. Let us be prepared for anything that St. Devors may have planned!"

Oracle Elf
